Summary.en: Applies input masking and formatting (dates, phone numbers, credit cards, …) via Cleave.js.
Summary.de: Wendet Eingabemaskierung und -formatierung (Datum, Telefonnummern, Kreditkarten, …) über Cleave.js an.
Summary.it: Applica mascheramento e formattazione dell'input (date, numeri di telefono, carte di credito, …) tramite Cleave.js.

Parameter.Config: The Cleave options to set instead of the other shorthand parameters.
Parameter.Date: Whether to enable Cleave's date masking.
Parameter.DateMin: The minimum date allowed, in American format with dashes (YYYY-MM-DD).
Parameter.DateMax: The maximum date allowed, in American format with dashes (YYYY-MM-DD).
Parameter.Delimiter: The delimiter used in the formatted value (e.g. '.', '/', '-').
Parameter.DatePattern: The date pattern (e.g. 'd-m-Y') used by the date mask.

Config.default: The Cleave options to set instead of the other shorthand parameters.

Date.default: Whether to enable Cleave's date masking.

DateMin.default: The minimum date allowed, in American format with dashes (YYYY-MM-DD).

DateMax.default: The maximum date allowed, in American format with dashes (YYYY-MM-DD).

Delimiter.default: The delimiter used in the formatted value (e.g. '.', '/', '-').

DatePattern.default: The date pattern (e.g. 'd-m-Y') used by the date mask.
